title: Saṅgam
subtitle: The Confluence
description: From the energetic Bhangra of Punjab and the graceful Bihu of Assam to the vibrant Kuchipudi of Andhra Pradesh and the electrifying Powada of Maharashtra, SANGAM brings the spirit of India alive on a single stage.  Where every heartbeat echoes a different culture, yet every soul beats for one nation. Students from across the country proudly represent their states through folk dances, music, ballads, poetry, and traditional art forms.  More than just an event, SANGAM is a celebration of India's rich cultural heritage, that promotes cultural exchange, strengthens national unity, and proves that while we have hundreds of traditions and beliefs, our identity as Indians remains one.
highlights: Students from each state represent their culture
Vibrant folk dances, music, and ballads
Celebration of India's rich cultural heritage
